title: Zesty Syrian Chickpea Flatbread
description: A salty, crunchy, and indulgent Syrian dish made with chickpea flour and a mirepoix base, perfect for a gluten-free friendly snack. It is traditionally served on a bamboo tray.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the chickpea flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the bowl and stir to combine.
Gradually add the olive oil and water to the bowl, stirring until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place the flatbreads on a bamboo tray lined with parchment paper.
Bake the flatbreads in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
